# Environment reference

Every variable the API reads, taken from its validation schema. The API refuses
to start when a required variable is missing or malformed.

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NODE_ENV` | no | `development` | Runtime mode. `production` refuses insecure defaults at boot (see `ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP`). |
| `ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP` | no | `false` | Permit `production` to run over plain HTTP. Session cookies then lose the `Secure` flag and travel in clear text. Only for a trusted private network. |
| `HOST` | no | `0.0.0.0` | Interface the API binds to. |
| `PORT` | no | `3000` | Port the API listens on. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | no | `info` | Floor for log output at startup. Per-feature levels are a runtime setting. |
| `LOG_DIR` | no | `logs` | Directory for the rotating file sink. |
| `STORAGE_BACKEND` | no | `local` | Where new attachments are written. Existing files keep the backend they were uploaded to until `cli storage:migrate` moves them. |
| `STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR` | no | `uploads` | Directory for the local backend. Must be a mounted volume: the container runs on a read-only root filesystem. |
| `STORAGE_MAX_UPLOAD_MB` | no | `50` | Hard ceiling on a single upload, enforced as it streams. This protects the server's memory; the per-organisation limit is the smaller `storage.uploads` setting. A request over this is cut off rather than read. |
| `S3_ENDPOINT` | no | _unset_ | S3 endpoint URL. Set it for MinIO/R2/Backblaze; omit it for AWS itself. |
| `S3_REGION` | no | `us-east-1` | S3 region. |
| `S3_BUCKET` | no | _unset_ | Bucket attachments are written to. |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | no | _unset_ | S3 access key. Omit both key vars to use the instance's ambient credentials. |
| `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | no | _unset_ | S3 secret key. |
| `S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE` | no | `false` | Use path-style URLs (`host/bucket/key`). MinIO needs this; AWS does not. |
| `GEOIP_DB` | no | _unset_ | Path to a MaxMind GeoLite2 `.mmdb` for geolocating security-event IPs. Unset (the default) records no location; see core/geoip.ts to enable. |
| `ALLOW_REGISTRATION` | no | `false` | Allow public self-service sign-up. Off by default — accounts are created by an administrator or by invitation. Superadmin and invite flows are unaffected. |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | no | `http://localhost:5173` | Comma-separated list of browser origins allowed to call the API. |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | no | `` | How to derive the client IP when the API runs behind a reverse proxy. Empty (the default) trusts no proxy — correct only when clients reach the API directly. Behind the bundled nginx set `1` (trust one hop); or give a comma-separated list of trusted proxy IPs/CIDRs. Without it, per-IP rate limits and audit IPs all see the proxy, not the client. Never set `true` on a public listener: any client could then spoof its IP. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | no | `postgres://reportly:reportly@localhost:5432/reportly` | Application Postgres database. |
| `LOG_DATABASE_URL` | no | `postgres://reportly:reportly@localhost:5432/reportly_logs` | Separate Postgres database for logs, so log volume never affects the app. |
| `PG_DUMP_CMD` | no | `pg_dump` | Command (argv, space-split) used to run pg_dump for backups. |
| `PG_RESTORE_CMD` | no | `pg_restore` | Command (argv, space-split) used to run pg_restore for restores. |
| `ALLOW_DEV_RESTORE` | no | `false` | Set `true` to allow `cli restore:dev` to wipe this database and load a production backup into it. Development machines only. |
| `ALLOW_DEV_SEED` | no | `false` | Set `true` to allow `cli seed:activity` to generate demo journal entries, tasks, rotas and points in this database. Development machines only. |
| `QUEUE_ADMIN` | no | `off` | Queue management: `off` (default, routes not mounted), `read` (view only), or `manage` (retry, remove, pause, clean). |
| `REDIS_URL` | no | `redis://localhost:6379` | Redis for sessions, caches, rate limits and the job queue. The `/N` db index is honoured. |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` | no | `dev-only-insecure-secret-change-me` | Signs sessions and cookies. **Must** be replaced in every real environment. |
| `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | no | `http://localhost:3000` | The API's externally reachable origin, used to build auth callback URLs. |
| `SMTP_HOST` | no | `localhost` | Outbound mail host (dev: Mailpit). |
| `SMTP_PORT` | no | `1025` | Outbound mail port. |
| `SMTP_SECURE` | no | `false` | Use TLS when connecting to SMTP. |
| `SMTP_USER` | no | _unset_ | SMTP username, when the relay requires one. |
| `SMTP_PASS` | no | _unset_ | SMTP password, when the relay requires one. |
| `MAIL_FROM` | no | `Reportly <no-reply@reportly.local>` | From address on invitations and password-reset emails. |
| `WEB_URL` | no | `http://localhost:5173` | Where the web app is served. Emailed links point here. |
| `SUPERADMIN_EMAIL` | no | `admin@reportly.local` | Seeded superadmin. Set its password with `cli reset-superadmin`. |
| `SUPERADMIN_NAME` | no | `Super Admin` | Seeded superadmin's name. |
